quota_unit: Kaggle accelerator-session wall seconds; T4x2 quota is charged by session runtime, not multiplied by visible GPUs

training.parallelism: Both arms for each seed run concurrently, one process per T4; five seed pairs remain sequential.

independent_gpu_reference.purpose: FD-RK4 spatial refinements plus temporal halving on cuda:0; failure or timeout blocks all field scoring

common_scoring.purpose: fixed-reference inference, held-out residual and metric export

unallocated_safety_reserve.use: absorbs startup overhead, checkpoint/score variance, or an optional smoke; never hyperparameter search or seed replacement

arithmetic: 300 setup + 2700 reference + 3000 paired training wall + 600 scoring + 600 reserve = 7200 quota seconds
device_seconds_arithmetic: 2700 reference + 6000 training + 600 scoring = 9300 active-device allocation seconds (2.5833 T4-device-hours); T4x2 second device is idle during reference and scoring
notes: The five paired seeds fit arithmetically only if the reference passes within 2700 seconds and both arm processes actually run concurrently on separate T4s.
The 2-hour quota includes an external 300-second setup allowance; script execution stops by 6900 seconds.
An optional 240-second transport smoke is charged to the 600-second safety reserve; it must not be added to a full run after that reserve is spent.
T4 runtime for the GPU reference is unknown; 2700 seconds is a hard stop, not an estimate or promise.
If reference generation exceeds its cap or fails its convergence gates, the campaign must not emit field-error scores.
Kaggle quota is measured as session runtime for T4x2; device-seconds count only the T4 actually assigned to each process.
